findings: deliverable contract declares typed_verifier_command against artifact_path 'out/<id>.json', which carries an unexpanded template token <id>; a typed verifier is handed one concrete path and cannot expand it; deliverable contract artifact_path 'out/<id>.json' carries an unexpanded template token <id> with no instance binding, so the gate can neither pass nor fail against it. Declare instance_artifact_field together with instance_source_path (or registry_path) and instance_source_records_field (or registry_records_field) so every instance is named by a source entry, or declare min_instances >= 1 so the expansion is a claim that can fail.
typed_verifier_command requires isolated command execution, deferred in R2a
